subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 05/11] mountd: retry unresolvable fsid lookups on the netlink downcall

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service to retry unresolvable file system ID (fsid) lookups on netlink downcalls. The fsid lookup is moved out of nfsd_handle_fh() and into a separate function, lookup_fsid(), which returns one of three possible values: FSID_LOOKUP_ANSWER (definitive), FSID_LOOKUP_RETRY (not resolvable yet), or FSID_LOOKUP_IGNORE (unusable). If the fsid lookup fails initially, it is added to a list of deferred netlink requests and retried on the same cadence as pipefs requests. This change helps prevent spurious ESTALE errors when the filesystem becomes available soon after the initial lookup failure.
